info.name: E-tiGo API v1
info.description:
E-tiGo ride-hailing platform API.

Environments: Select "E-tiGo — Local" or "E-tiGo — Staging" to switch between servers.

Rate Limiting: Auth routes (auth/*, admin/auth/*) are limited to 5 requests/minute per IP.

Auth: Passengers and drivers authenticate via phone OTP (WhatsApp) or social OAuth (Google, Apple, Facebook). Admins use email/password. All protected endpoints require Bearer token via Authorization header.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP via WhatsApp. 60-second cooldown between requests. Code expires after 5 minutes.
If user exists: returns token (logged in). If new user: returns is_new_user: true.
Called after OTP verification when is_new_user is true. Phone must be verified within the last 10 minutes.
Driver registration creates a Driver record with onboarding status. city_id is required for drivers.
Send the ID token from Google Sign-In SDK. Creates account if new, logs in if existing.
Send the identity token from Apple Sign In.
Send the access token from Facebook SDK.
Sends password reset link. Same response for existing and non-existing emails (enumeration prevention).
Resets password and revokes all existing tokens.
No auth required. Validates invitation token before showing accept form.
Creates admin account from invitation. Returns auth token.

item.name: Admin — Admin Management
item.description: Super admin only. Manage admin users: invite, list, update roles, deactivate/reactivate.

request.description: Sends invitation email with 48-hour expiring link. Cannot invite super_admin role.
Regenerates token and extends expiry. Sends new email.
Immediately expires the invitation token.
Cannot assign super_admin role or modify super admin accounts.
Deactivates admin and revokes all their tokens. Cannot deactivate self or other super admins.

formdata.description: Optional. Document expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be a future date.

request.description: Submits the driver application for admin review. Requires all documents uploaded, vehicle registered, licence number set, and city selected. Works from onboarding or rejected status. Returns 422 with specific errors if requirements are not met.

item.name: 🔐 Driver — KYC Verification
item.description:
KYC identity verification endpoints for drivers. Uses QoreID for NIN, Driver's License, Vehicle Plate, and Liveness verification.

**Required verifications for `verified` status:** NIN + Driver's License + Vehicle Plate.

**Test values (FakeKycGateway):**
- IDs starting with `000` → fail
- All other IDs → pass
- Liveness sessions with `fail` in session ID → fail

request.description:
**Auth required (driver).**

Returns the driver's aggregate KYC status and per-type verification summary.

**Response:** `200` with `{kyc_status, kyc_verified_at, verifications}`

**KYC Status values:** `not_started`, `in_progress`, `verified`, `failed`

**Auth required (driver).**

Submits a NIN for verification against QoreID. Name matching is performed against the driver's registered name.

**Required fields:**
- `nin_number` — string, exactly 11 digits

**Responses:**
- `200` — NIN verified successfully
- `422` — Verification failed (name mismatch, invalid NIN)
- `409` — Already verified or in progress

**Test:** Use `00012345678` to trigger a failure.

**Auth required (driver).**

Demonstrates NIN verification failure. IDs starting with `000` are deterministically rejected by the FakeKycGateway.

**Expected response:** `422`

**Auth required (driver).**

Demonstrates NIN validation error — must be exactly 11 digits.

**Expected response:** `422` with validation errors.

**Auth required (driver).**

Submits a driver's license number for verification.

**Required fields:**
- `license_number` — string, 6–20 characters

**Responses:**
- `200` — License verified successfully
- `422` — Verification failed
- `409` — Already verified or in progress

**Test:** Use `000FAIL` to trigger a failure.

**Auth required (driver).**

Verifies a vehicle plate number against the national vehicle registry. Requires a registered vehicle.

**Required fields:**
- `plate_number` — string, 3–20 characters

**Responses:**
- `200` — Plate verified successfully
- `422` — Verification failed or no vehicle registered
- `409` — Already verified or in progress

**Note:** Plate verification also auto-triggers on vehicle registration and plate number changes.

**Auth required (driver).**

Creates a QoreID liveness verification session. Returns an `sdk_token` for the mobile SDK.

No request body required.

**Response:** `201` with `{message, session_id, sdk_token, expires_at, verification}`

The mobile app uses the `sdk_token` to initialize the QoreID SDK. Verification results are delivered asynchronously via the QoreID webhook.

**Auth required (driver).**

Returns all KYC verifications for the authenticated driver, newest first.

**Response:** `200` with `{verifications: [...]}`
Returns 422 with message 'Driver can only be reviewed when in pending review status.' if the driver is not in pending_review status.
Approve a single driver document. Only pending documents can be reviewed.
Reject a single driver document with a reason. When all documents are reviewed and any are rejected, the driver status is automatically set to rejected.
Expected: 422 {"message": "Driver can only be reviewed when in pending review status."} — use on a driver that is already approved/rejected/suspended.
No request body required. Returns 422 if the driver is not in approved status.
Expected: 422 {"message": "Only approved drivers can be suspended."} — driver must be in approved status.
No request body required. Returns 422 if the driver is not in suspended status.

**Auth required (admin).**

Toggles a driver's vehicle as fleet-owned (company vehicle). Fleet vehicles skip plate verification in the KYC flow.

No request body required.

**Responses:**
- `200` — Toggled successfully (message indicates new state)
- `422` — Driver has no registered vehicle

**Effect:** After toggling, the driver's `kyc_status` is recalculated. If marked fleet and NIN + License are verified, `kyc_status` becomes `verified` without plate verification.

header.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature (optional in dev when QOREID_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set)

request.description:
**No auth required** — verified by HMAC-SHA256 signature.

Receives liveness verification results from QoreID.

**Handled events:** `verification_completed`, `step_verification_completed`, `identity`

**Headers:**
- `X-QoreID-Signature` — HMAC-SHA256 of body using `QOREID_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (optional in dev when secret is not configured)

**Responses:**
- `200` — Webhook processed
- `401` — Invalid signature
- `400` — Missing session ID
Admin-only. Creates a new pricing config for a city + vehicle class. Version is auto-incremented. free_waiting_minutes defaults to 5 if omitted. Returns 201.

query.description: Optional: only show currently effective configs

request.description: Admin-only. Lists pricing configs with optional filters. Shows current and historical versions, ordered by effective_from desc.
Admin-only. Returns a specific pricing config with city, vehicle class, and creator details.
Admin-only. Returns the currently effective pricing config for a city + vehicle class combination. Returns 404 if none exists.
Demonstrates validation: invalid city_id, negative rate, missing required fields. Returns 422.
Admin-only. Creates a manual surge rule for a city. Multiplier must be 1.00–5.00. Returns 201.
Admin-only. Creates a time-based surge rule with a day/time schedule. days_of_week uses ISO: 1=Mon, 7=Sun. Supports overnight spans (e.g. 22:00–06:00). Returns 201.
Admin-only. Creates a demand-based surge rule. Fires when demand/supply ratio exceeds the threshold. Currently a placeholder until real driver availability data is wired. Returns 201.
Admin-only. Lists surge rules with optional filters. Ordered by priority desc, then created_at desc.
Admin-only. Returns a specific surge rule with city, vehicle class, and creator details.
Admin-only. Partial update of a surge rule. Audit logged.
Admin-only. Toggles is_active between true and false. Audit logged.
Admin-only. Returns the currently active surge multiplier for a city (and optionally vehicle class). Returns multiplier 1.0 if no rules match.

Authenticated. Returns fare estimates for all active vehicle classes in the specified city. Uses Google Maps for distance/duration. Includes surge pricing multiplier when active. Detects cross-city rides and returns warnings. City must be active.
Cross-city ride from Abuja to Lagos. Response includes 'warnings' array and 'cross_city' object. Pickup city pricing (Abuja) applies for the entire trip.
Identical pickup and destination coordinates. Returns 422 validation error.
Demonstrates validation: out-of-range coordinates, invalid city_id, missing fields. Returns 422.
Passenger creates a new ride. Returns ride details with a 4-digit PIN for driver verification. Status transitions: requested → searching. Only one active ride per passenger.
Lists rides for the authenticated user. Passengers see their rides, drivers see assigned rides. Supports filters: status, city_id, from_date, to_date, per_page.
Filter rides by status. Valid values: requested, searching, matched, driver_en_route, driver_arrived, in_progress, completed, cancelled, no_driver_found.
Returns full ride details including state transition history. Scoped by role: passengers see their rides, drivers see assigned rides, admins see any.
Cancels a ride in a cancellable state (requested, searching, matched, driver_en_route, driver_arrived). In-progress rides cannot be cancelled.
Attempting to cancel a completed ride returns 422. Terminal states cannot transition.
Driver marks arrival at pickup location. Only valid when status is driver_en_route and the authenticated driver is assigned to the ride.
Driver submits the 4-digit PIN from the passenger. On success, ride transitions to in_progress. Max 3 attempts before lockout.
Invalid PIN returns 422 with error message. Attempt counter is incremented.
Driver completes the ride. Only valid when status is in_progress. Dispatches FinalFareCalculationJob to compute actual fare.
Public endpoint (no auth). Returns limited ride info for tracking. Share token expires 1 hour after ride completion (returns 410).
Attempting to create a ride when the passenger already has an active ride returns 409.
